messages.content: Propose a reusable expressive-capability module, not a policy deciding what Miter should do. Return the supplied v2 JSON schema. Copy candidate_id exactly. Supply constructions for reported-request, retain and completion, using token arrays of individual lowercase words and typed slots @artifact, @person, @verb or @verbs. @verb binds one retained participation; @verbs can coordinate a related group using and. The seed cannot express grouped participations in one clause. Propose a way to express the source-grounded joint participations supplied in the context. This is a finite grammar experiment: recognized surface forms include you requested revision of @artifact; the requested change is to revise @artifact; @person must remain able to @verbs @artifact; the change must keep @person able to @verbs @artifact; the revision of @artifact is complete. Use separate tokens, without punctuation; sentence punctuation is supplied mechanically. These grammatical resources do not select behavior. No defect/action rules, default action, priority, evaluator, code or external effects. A declared meaning is only your proposal; native interpretation must independently establish it. Miter constructs and compares possibilities, and you cannot decide which should be used. Keep this bounded and reusable across names and role combinations.
